failed: The PDF could not be created. No incomplete file is available for download.
unsupported: This email contains unsupported content, a missing or unreadable embedded image, or content that cannot fit the print layout.

incomplete: This email is incomplete or an embedded resource could not be read. Export a complete copy with its local resources and try again.
rtfOnly: This Outlook email has only a compressed RTF body, which cannot be converted. Save an EML copy with readable HTML or plain text in your mail app and try again.
remoteNotice: Remote images and other external resources were omitted. Nothing was fetched from the sender or a tracking server.
attachmentNotice: Only attachment names, types, sizes and roles are listed. Attached files and attached emails are not included in this PDF.
verificationNotice: Sender identity, digital signatures and delivery have not been verified.
styleNotice: This copy uses a simple reading layout. Original styles and active content are omitted.
noBody: This email has no readable message body. Its available headers and attachments are shown above.
invalidDate: The saved date is missing or malformed. It is shown without conversion when available.
utcDate: This Outlook timestamp is stored in UTC. The original sender’s time zone is not available.
signed: This message contains a digital signature. Signature validity is not checked.
